P0340.title: Open problem: Growth of the minimal drawn length of critical beta-splitting trees
P0340.body:
OPEN PROBLEM from the Codex campaign ledger (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status candidate_full_solution). Determine the expected total vertical length in the minimal integer-height drawing of DTCS(n); the source specifically proposes growth on the scale n*(log n)^4. Source: Aldous-Janson: Critical beta-splitting random tree II, overview and open problems, Open Problem14,PDF54-55.
Posed in Aldous-Janson: Critical beta-splitting random tree II, overview and open problems
Status as recorded in the campaign ledger on 2026-09-07

C0036.title: Open problem: Fuglede-Kadison product-measure bounds for equivariant determinantal processes
C0036.body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status partial_result). For every Gamma-equivariant positive contraction Q on l^2(Gamma), P_Q stochastically dominates the product measure with density FK(Q) = exp tr log|Q| and is dominated by the product measure with density 1 - FK(I-Q), and these bounds are optimal; open even for finite groups. Source: Lyons: Determinantal probability, basic properties and conjectures, ICM 2014, Conjecture 5.7, p. 23.
Posed in Lyons: Determinantal probability, basic properties and conjectures, ICM 2014
Current status unverified as of 2026-09-07

C0003.title: Open problem: Bypassing the Laplace-transform tail condition for the DGFF extremal measure
C0003.body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). Prove that any family of non-trivial random measures {Z^D : D in the class of admissible domains} obeying properties (1)-(4) of Theorem 10.15 (Gibbs-Markov, conformal covariance, positivity, non-atomicity) automatically satisfies property (5), the Laplace-transform tail asymptotics, for some c hat > 0. Source: Biskup: Extrema of the two-dimensional discrete Gaussian free field, PIMS-CRM lecture notes, Conjecture 16.3, p. 220.

C0085.body:

C0131.title: Open problem: Recurrence-transience dichotomy for excited random walks in dimension d >= 2
C0131.body:

For excited random walks on Z^d, d >= 2, with i.i.d. uniformly elliptic cookie environments, is the walk either recurrent (visits every site infinitely often... in the source's Definition 3.1 sense) or transient? P0016.title: Open problem: Worst square-submatrix conditioning in a Gaussian frame
P0016.body:
OPEN PROBLEM from the Codex campaign ledger (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). P0046.title: Open problem: Connecting a free uniform spanning forest by arbitrarily sparse invariant additions
P0046.body:

For any Cayley graph, its free uniform spanning forest F, and epsilon>0, is there an invariant connected random spanning subgraph omega containing F with P(e in omega minus F)<epsilon for every edge e?
